messages:
ops-bot: [CRITICAL] 09:17 UTC — control-plane: config propagation > 90s in eu-central1. cfg-queue depth=124, API writes timing out. alert: cfg.propagation.delay.high
sam: seeing lots of 500s from controlplane-config, rollouts not completing. console config sync stuck.
megan: consoles in eu-central1 returning 502s, users can't push Dedicated config changes. who is oncall for eu?
raj: I'm on it. pulling logs. ran `kubectl -n controlplane get pods | grep eu-central1` — multiple controlplane pods CrashLoopBackOff.
lin: seeing PG connection spikes to controlplane-db-eu, replication lag high. suspect inter-AZ networking flaps.
olivia: traces show repeated grpc stream errors: `rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed` on config service.
dinesh: leader election chatter in logs — frequent leader flips (term 23 -> 24 -> 23). likely split-brain symptoms.
raj: logs excerpt:
```
leader_election: step_down
term=23 -> term=24
error: failed to commit log: context deadline exceeded
```

sam: suggestion: roll back last config canary (v2.14.3 -> v2.14.2) and pause further rollouts. deploy-bot: rollback initiated (controlplane-config canary id=dc-4729).
megan: also seeing auth token failures (401) for some controlplane routes — probably tied to config cache misses. console authz proxy timeouts.
raj: proposed plan: 1) pause new rollouts in eu-central1 2) avoid full failover, promote na-west2 standby for reads 3) route non-critical traffic to na-west2 via smart-router 4) scale controlplane pods in eu +3 5) evict low-priority GPU jobs from na-west2 if we shift traffic.
lin: executed: paused rollouts (flag set). queued smart-router change: `if controlplane_latency_eu>200ms prefer na-west2 for non-critical routes` :eyes:
olivia: note — na-west2 has limited spare capacity this week (reserved jobs). full failover will hit capacity/cost limits.
dinesh: cost estimate: spinning burst capacity (ephemeral GPUs) in na-west2 ~ $4.2k/day if sustained; ok for short window (6-12h) to stabilize.
sam: evicting batch-inference (low-pri) from na-west2 to free ~30% GPUs, fallback to apac spot nodes.
megan: rollback completed and canary stopped. controlplane pod restarts are decreasing, health checks returning 200.
raj: DB replication catching up: replication_lag -> 8s (was 120s). leader stable for 2m.
olivia: auth 401s dropping, console writes succeeding again.
ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: control plane config propagation latency degraded in eu-central1. Actions: rollback, paused rollouts, scaled eu controlplane, shifted non-critical traffic to na-west2, evicted low-pri jobs. No customer data loss observed. Severity downgraded P0 -> P1.
dinesh: postmortem TODOs: (1) leader election hardening (increase election timeouts, investigate split-brain triggers) (2) AZ networking tests and better cross-AZ failover docs (3) add automatic routing fallback runbook + cost guardrails (4) improve monitoring for config-queue depth and rapid rollback triggers.
sam: thanks team — keeping channel open for 1h to watch stability. :thumbsup:
